unavailableDescription: Domain configuration could not be loaded. Retry to check this address again.
unknownDescription: This address is not a configured platform or registered tenant domain.
invalid: Enter a hostname without protocol, port, path or wildcard.
dnsFqdnHint: The host below is the full DNS name. If your DNS provider expects a relative host, remove only the exact zone suffix it manages.
sslUnknownDescription: Default domains use the platform wildcard certificate. Deployment must confirm its coverage, expiry and renewal.
certificateDeploymentHint: Certificate issuance or storage does not mean the website is serving HTTPS. A platform operator must install the certificate and configure the reverse proxy for this domain. Automatic issuance also requires platform DNS provider credentials.
publicationUnconfirmed: HTTPS publication status is not recorded
publicationInstallStep: After issuance, upload or renewal, ask a platform operator to publish the current certificate and domain route to the site's reverse proxy. Changing automatic renewal only saves the certificate renewal preference.
publicationVerifyStep: After publication, verify this domain over HTTPS, including the certificate hostname and chain. This screen does not confirm that the current certificate has been installed.

managedHttps.label: Managed wildcard HTTPS
managedHttps.uncovered: Certificate does not cover this domain
managedHttps.description: This status comes from the installed deployment certificate, including its domain coverage and expiry. The platform manages this certificate.
managedHttps.manualRenew: Automatic renewal is disabled. A platform operator must renew and install the deployment certificate before expiry.
